context: Hina-young goes solo on a bus for a school field trip; phone call with Yumiko.
purpose: Teen taking small independent travel; reassuring grandmother.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: おばあちゃん、バス乗ってるよ。
lines.en: Grandma, I'm on the bus now.
lines.style: Bright, sunny opening. Quick report—a child sharing a small update with someone she trusts. Warm and present. No anxiety, just inclusion.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: まあ、無事に到着してね。
lines.en: Oh, make sure you get there safely.
lines.style: Gentle, maternal softness. A quiet exhale—worry held loosely, not pressed. Practical care wrapped in tenderness. The mom who lets go but stays present.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: I'm okay even though I'm alone.
lines.style: Confident and small at once. A child reassuring the adult, not performing bravery but stating fact. Warm—no defensiveness, just clarity and trust.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: Soft permission. A mother releasing her child into the day. Warm, steady tone. Not dismissing the worry but choosing joy instead. Gentle conviction.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright and easy. A promise made without heaviness. Quick, warm, genuine. The natural rhythm of a child comfortable saying goodbye because she knows it isn't final.
